metadata.overview: Heatbit BitAir - HEPA air purifier with a solo bitcoin miner inside. Firmware is ESP-Miner-derived and serves an AxeOS-style local HTTP API. Controls purification and mining; reports air quality and miner telemetry. Operations affect physical hardware - prioritize thermal safety.

telemetry.name: hashrate_ghs
telemetry.description: Real-time hashrate. BitAir hashes in the ~1 TH/s class.

telemetry.name: temp_c
telemetry.description: ASIC board temperature. Above 85°C requires intervention.

telemetry.name: pm25_ugm3
telemetry.description: Ambient PM2.5 concentration in µg/m³ from the device's own sensor, as a string. The canonical unit vocabulary has no mass-concentration unit yet; parse as float.

telemetry.name: power_mode
telemetry.description: Active purification power mode: off, eco, low or high.

telemetry.name: mining
telemetry.description: 'true' when the solo miner is hashing.

commands.name: setFanSpeed
commands.description: Sets the purifier fan speed as a percentage.

commands.name: setMining
commands.description: Enables or disables the solo miner. Purification continues.

commands.name: reboot
commands.constraints: Do not call more than once per 5 minutes.

errors.ERR_BAD_POWER_MODE: The device rejected the requested power mode.
errors.ERR_BAD_FAN_SPEED: The fan percent is outside the device's supported range.
errors.ERR_DEVICE_CALL_FAILED: The device's HTTP API call failed or returned an error.
